name: Blasting Stone
description_html: When this pebble hits a creature or a hard surface, it explodes with a deafening bang. A blasting stone deals the listed sonic damage and sonic splash damage, and each creature within 10 feet of the space in which the stone exploded must succeed at a Fortitude saving throw with the listed DC or be deafened until the end of its next turn. Many types of blasting stones grant an item bonus to attack rolls.
